question: Who was named Player of the Tournament in the ICC Under-19 Men’s Cricket World Cup 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaibhav Suryavanshi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• Vaibhav Suryavanshi was adjudged Player of the Tournament at the ICC Under-19 World Cup 2026.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Award**: Player of the Tournament.
 
• **Total Runs**: 439.
 
• **Strike Rate**: 169.49.
 
• **Boundary Hits**: Most sixes (30) in the competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Player of the Tournament__: Presented to the standout performer across all matches.
 
• __Award Criteria__: Based on runs, strike rate, match-winning contributions.
 
• __Statistical Impact__: High batting metrics and consistency.
 
• __ICC Awards__: Includes individual and team recognitions post-tournament.
